fusions.name: Silver Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a darting shot that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the original damage each. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Net
fusions.desc: Draws a net of bars tight around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. You slip free, moving 25% faster for 4 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Bait Shoal
fusions.desc: Casts a lure that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A shoal of silver fish fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Glancing Bars
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
